violations.why: ISR can preempt the task between the write at line 14 and the read at line 15, breaking atomicity.
ISR can run after line 14 and before line 16, interleaving a write between two task accesses.
ISR may interrupt after the initial write and before the final read, violating atomicity.
A read at line 15 can be followed by an ISR write before the next read at line 16.
The ISR write can occur between the reads on lines 15 and 17.
An ISR write can interpose between the reads on lines 16 and 17.
